{{For|[[Farm]]}} {{MapInfobox |image1 = |-|Icon = [[File:FarmLandsIcon.png]] |-|View = [[File:FarmLandsView.png]] |-|Top Down = [[File:FarmLandsTopDown.png]] |developer = ''3ʳᵈ – Current'' - Your_Adversary
''1ˢᵗ – 2ⁿᵈ'' - BiscuitTurtleKid & Beefchoplets |difficulty = Normal |length_measurement = 00:40.28 |wave_structure = Beta Normal |rewards = {{RewardsList|Normal|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}} |modifiers = [[Enemies Beta]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Farm Lands''' is, as the name suggests, a farm-based [[Maps|map]]. It has been remade twice since its addition to the game. '''Farm Lands''' has the [[Enemies Beta]] modifier, which changes the appearance of some enemies, replaces some enemies with other enemies and changes stats of some enemies. ==Design & Path== {{Tabber |Current |The current version of '''Farm Lands''' takes place on a large farm plain surrounded by hills, a cliff and large patches of farmland. In the background, a large stone bridge can be seen. On the farm, there is a green wooden two story house and a red wooden barn. There are also 4 green houses, two water tanks, a water tower, a well, a mailbox and a board set on the property. A green car, red truck and red tractor can be found on the farm. Multiple trees, rocks, red barrels, cable reels and hay bales are also scattered across the map. The path starts at a cave, goes around the water tower and truck, around the water tanks and then goes straight into the barn. |Version 3 |The third version of '''Farm Lands''' took place on a large farm plain with gentle hills. In the background, another farm could be seen. Separating the main farm and far farm were wheatfields with hay bales. On the main farm, multiple farm barns and farmhouses could be seen. Various water tanks and grain silos could be seen. Small scale grainfields, fences and hay bales could also be seen. Several birch and oak trees could be seen. The brown pebble path begins at a cave and ends at a barn. |Version 2 |The second version of '''Farm Lands''' is identical to the first version, except terrain water surrounded the map, instead of baseplate water. |Version 1 |The first version of '''Farm Lands''' took place a farming island in the middle of the ocean. Green fields could be seen across the map. Barns, wheatfields, hay bales, silos, windmills and trees could also be seen across the map. There were also hill mounds to place cliff towers on. The path started at a cave and ended at a barn. It took a roughly circular path around the map. }} ==Interactive Map== {{Map:Farm Lands}} ==Rewards== The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map. Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. {{Rewards|Normal|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}} ==Strategy== *The path on this map is quite compact, meaning that high range towers such as the [[Turret]], [[Ranger]] or [[Mortar]] can cover most or all the path with proper positioning. **Additionally, you can use [[DJ Booth]] to boost the range of said towers, further increasing their effectiveness. *The path's shape is ideal for the [[Ace Pilot]] and [[Pursuit]], as it allows them to cover a part of the path for most of their flight path. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Map Icons}} Farm Lands.png|First & second versions (25 November 2019 – 8 May 2021) FL logo.png|Third version (8 May 2021 – 24 June 2023) {{GalleryHeader|View}} FLView.png|First version (25 November 2019 – 29 October 2020) FV.png|Second version (29 October 2020 – 8 May 2021) FarmlandsView.png|Third version (8 May 2021 – 24 June 2023) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Game Master Ultimate Skin - Tower Defense Simulator|Current version on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator Trailer|First version in the game trailer. Tower Defense Simulator Frost Invasion Trailer|Third version in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Development Images}} FarmLandsDI1.png|Third version on a development image. FarmLandsDI2.png|Third version on a development image. FarmLandsDI3.png|Current version on a development image. FarmLandsDI4.png|Current version on a development image. }} ==Trivia== *The current version of this map is based on the [[Rotfield]] map. Most notably, the path layout is the same and it has a bridge present on the side of the map. **Additionally, the "''Rotfield''" text can be found on the mailbox on this map, implying that the '''Farm Lands''' map may take place in the same area or location as the [[Rotfield]] map. *A hamburger could be seen inside two of the barns on the original version of '''Farm Lands'''. However, they could only be spotted in free camera mode. **This was a reference to [https://www.roblox.com/users/209546354/profile Beefchoplets's] old avatar, which featured a hamburger. ==Update History== *'''25 November 2019''' - [[Release v1.3|Release v1.3.0]] **'''Farm Lands''' added. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **{{Color|Normal}} difficulty added. **Baseplate water replaced with terrain water. **No longer gives a badge upon first triumph. *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **'''Farm Lands''' remade. **Difficulty changed from {{Color|Normal}} to {{Color|Hard}}. *'''24 June 2023''' - [[v1.8.2]] **'''Farm Lands''' remade. **[[Enemies Beta]] modifier added. *'''25 October 2024''' - [[v1.38.0]] **Difficulty changed from {{Color|Hard}} to {{Color|Normal}} *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **{{Bug}} '''Farm Lands''' cannot be chosen in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]]. {{MapNavBox}}
